identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of TQB2102 for Injection in the Treatment of HER2-positive Biliary Tract Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Immunogenicity of TQB2102 for Injection in the Treatment of HER2-positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Cancer

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety TQB2102 for injection in the treatment of patients with Her2-positive biliary tract cancer.

armGroups.label: TQB2102 for injection
armGroups.description: Intravenous infusion, administered every 3 weeks, 21 days as a treatment cycle, 6/8 cycles.

interventions.name: TQB2102 for injection
interventions.description: TQB2102 for injection is a HER2 dual-antibody-drug Conjugate (ADC)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AE) and serious adverse events (SAE)
primaryOutcomes.description: Any adverse medical event that occurred from the time the subject signed the informed consent until 28 days after the last dose/start of the new antitumor therapy (whichever came first).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the time the subject signed the informed consent until 28 days after the last dose/start of the new antitumor therapy

secondaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of subjects achieving complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) as assessed by the investigator based on the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST) version 1.1.
The time between first medication and first disease progression or death from any cause.
The first assessment was complete response, partial response, and time to disease stabilization.
First assessed as complete or partial response to first disease progression or time of death from all causes.
Time from first use to death from any cause
